variables.name: EGATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the administrator sign-in; use a long unique value.

variables.name: EGATE_RESEND_API_KEY
variables.description: Resend API key used by egate’s worker to deliver queued email; required in production.

variables.name: EGATE_DB
variables.description: Persistent SQLite database path for app keys, queue, per-IP counts, and jail. Keep the Uppr database at ./data/main.sqlite.

variables.name: EGATE_HOST
variables.description: Server listen interface, not the public gateway URL used by clients. Use 0.0.0.0 in Uppr.

variables.name: EGATE_PORT
variables.description: HTTP listen port. Uppr maps this value to the container; defaults to 8119.

variables.name: EGATE_LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS
variables.description: Failed administrator logins allowed per IP in a rolling 24 hour window.
